summary: run_scheduled_op hard-blocks on durable would_pause_next_cycle or critical/exhausted budget pressure even when remaining tokens > est, matching fleet/PM/AutonomyEngine surface rails (#634/#871).

agent_notes: Do not run scheduled ops when budget_pressure is critical/exhausted or would_pause_next_cycle is true. Prior note-only path was a no-op; resolve budget_gate first.
